user.title: Windhager Unified — connection
user.description:
Enter the local address of your Windhager web server and your credentials.

No `http://` prefix needed — HTTP (port 80) is tried first, HTTPS as fallback.

Need help finding your password? See the [setup guide]({docs_url}).

data_description.host: IP address or hostname, e.g. 192.168.1.61 or windhager.local. A scheme (http:// / https://) is optional.
data_description.username: Use 'Service' for full read/write access. 'USER' for read-only. 'OEM' for manufacturer-level access.
data_description.password: Factory default is '123'. If your system is registered on Windhager Connect the password is set automatically — log in at connect.windhager.com → settings → 'Change web server password' → show current password.

experience.title: Experience level
experience.description: Choose how much detail you want. Essential gives a clean dashboard; Service exposes all data and write actions.

data_description.experience_level: essential = temperatures + operating state only; comfort = + setpoints and DHW; advanced = + error log and VPN; expert = all discovered datapoints; service = all + write actions (requires Service credentials)

discover.title: Discovering your system…
discover.description: Connecting to the device and reading the LON network topology. This may take a few seconds.

groups.title: Functional groups
groups.description: Select which groups to include. Detected boiler: {boiler}. Tier: {tier}.

history.title: History storage
history.description: Choose how datapoint history is stored. The Home Assistant Recorder is always used; the dedicated archive is additional long-term storage for model development.

history_advanced.title: Archive settings
history_advanced.description: Configure the dedicated Windhager archive. These settings do not affect the Home Assistant Recorder.

data_description.history_sample_interval: Minimum interval between archived samples for continuously changing measurements. State transitions and configuration changes are stored immediately.
data_description.history_retention_days: Number of days retained in the dedicated Windhager archive. This does not change the Home Assistant Recorder retention period.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Windhager device. Check host and network.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one instance of this device is allowed.

init.title: Windhager Options
init.description: Changing the experience level or groups will reload the integration.

data_description.refresh_labels_from_device: Fetches the latest label XML files from the device's /res/xml/ endpoint. Disabled by default. Falls back to bundled labels on any error.
data_description.history_storage_mode: Home Assistant Recorder is always used. The dedicated archive stores additional data for model development.

history_advanced.title: Archive settings
history_advanced.description: Configure the dedicated Windhager archive. These settings do not affect the Home Assistant Recorder.

data_description.history_sample_interval: Minimum interval between archived samples for continuously changing measurements. State transitions and configuration changes are stored immediately.
data_description.history_retention_days: Number of days retained in the dedicated Windhager archive. This does not change the Home Assistant Recorder retention period.

options.essential: Essential — temperatures and operating state only
options.advanced: Advanced — + error log, heartbeat, VPN, system time
options.service: Service — all data + write actions (requires Service credentials)
